lead.headline: Senate blocks crypto market bill as Democrats hold out on ethics
lead.dek: Cloture on the Clarity Act fails 49-50; Tillis enters a motion to reconsider and bitcoin slides 4%
body: The Senate on Tuesday refused to take up the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, the crypto industry's top legislative priority, after every Democrat present and four Republicans voted against ending debate on a motion to proceed to the House-passed bill. The 49-50 vote fell 11 short of the 60 needed, and the bill now faces an uncertain path to becoming law.

Sens. Susan Collins, Josh Hawley, Jerry Moran and Thom Tillis were the Republicans voting no, the Senate record shows; Tillis entered a motion to reconsider that keeps the bill alive. Democrats said an ethics clause meant to bar presidents and other officials from profiting from crypto in office was too weak because the Justice Department would enforce it, NPR reported.

The 600-page bill, a version of which passed the House last year, would split oversight of digital assets between the SEC and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. Bitcoin fell to $75,850, down 4.2% in 24 hours, CoinDesk reported. Sen. Ruben Gallego, D-Ariz., said Republican leaders "ended talks and forced a vote" while ethics negotiations were progressing.

briefs.headline: News helicopter crash in Los Angeles kills 3
briefs.summary: An NBC4 chopper covering a fatal bus wreck crashed in Chatsworth on Tuesday night, killing its photojournalist, its pilot and a pedestrian, fire officials said.

briefs.headline: Senate advances college sports overhaul bill on 74-24 vote
briefs.summary: The Protect College Sports Act cleared a filibuster Tuesday. It would cap athlete revenue sharing at 22% and allow one penalty-free transfer.

briefs.headline: Maduro ally Saab pleads guilty in Miami, agrees to cooperate
briefs.summary: Alex Saab admitted one money laundering count tied to Venezuelan food contracts Tuesday, agreed to forfeit $195 million and to aid federal probes.

briefs.headline: Fed expected to raise rates today for first time since 2023
briefs.summary: Futures put a roughly 90% chance on a quarter-point hike to 3.75%-4% at 2 p.m. ET, per CME FedWatch, with August CPI at 3.4%. Warsh speaks at 2:30.

briefs.headline: Saudi coalition says it downed Houthi drone bound for Mecca
briefs.summary: Spokesman Turki al-Maliki called the holy sites a "red line." The Houthis denied targeting Mecca and said they shot down a Saudi F-15 fighter.

briefs.headline: Russian drone strike on bus kills 5 near Nikopol
briefs.summary: Gov. Oleksandr Hanzha said the minibus was hit Wednesday morning in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, wounding at least 7. Russia launched 80 drones overnight.

briefs.headline: Sudan gold mine collapse kills at least 60, survivors say
briefs.summary: Shafts at the Al-Zaraa mine near El-Nahud caved in Tuesday and 60 bodies were retrieved by morning, survivors told AFP; more remain trapped.

briefs.headline: Hong Kong's John Lee unveils city's first five-year plan
briefs.summary: The plan through 2030 aligns the city with Beijing's and centers on a 30,000-hectare Northern Metropolis that Lee said would house 2.5M people.

briefs.headline: Lawmakers weigh keeping aging coal plants running
briefs.summary: FirstEnergy told the Joint Committee on Energy and Public Works on Tuesday it has spent $500M in five years on plants nearly 50 years old as demand grows.

briefs.headline: State tax collections run $46.1M ahead of estimate
briefs.summary: Revenue officials told the Joint Finance Committee on Tuesday the state took in $838.3M in the fiscal year's first two months, 5.8% above estimate.

briefs.headline: DOT will add contractor names to project dashboard
briefs.summary: Transportation Secretary Stephen Rumbaugh told an oversight commission Tuesday the agency will add prime contractors and dates to its dashboard, with no timeline.

briefs.headline: Benson launches WVU Express direct admission
briefs.summary: President Michael Benson said Monday qualifying seniors in Monongalia and Kanawha counties can be admitted without applying; 32 Kanawha students signed up in days.

regional.item: Icon Cinemas takes over the Marquee at Pullman Square Oct. 1 for a $6M, nine-month remodel adding a 10-lane bowling alley and arcade.
The Putnam County Commission will take up a Putnam United resolution seeking local say over hyperscale data centers at its Sept. 29 meeting.
Parkersburg council's finance committee voted 4-0 Tuesday to put $668,142 in unused federal housing money toward up to four new homes on city lots.
Pipestem State Park holds its first Oktoberfest Oct. 16-18, with a German buffet and free concert Friday and a car show and biergarten Saturday.

away.item: The village has joined a national PFAS class action seeking cleanup and firefighter-gear costs from chemical makers, the Banner reported Tuesday.

hotspots.item: The Webster County EDA voted Sept. 8 to make an offer on more than 50 DNR-owned acres near Big Ditch Lake for a possible RV park, the Echo reported Monday.
North Topsail Beach relaunches its town website today, Sept. 16, keeping the same navigation, at no added cost to taxpayers, the town said in a Sept. 14 notice.

briefs.headline: Prince George fields 9 mayoral candidates, most in B.C.
briefs.summary: Nine people are running for mayor, more than Vancouver or Victoria with eight each. Incumbent Simon Yu is among them; 19 seek eight council seats.

briefs.headline: RCMP investigate axe attack on downtown security guard
briefs.summary: A guard patrolling the 1100 block of 3rd Avenue was attacked with an axe just after 9 p.m. Sunday and suffered minor hand injuries, police said.

briefs.headline: B.C. court strikes rural rule for foreign-trained doctors
briefs.summary: The court found the province cannot make foreign medical graduates work in remote areas to get residency. Ravi Kahlon said the program will be revised.

briefs.headline: Harbour Air buys Pacific Coastal Airlines in B.C. merger
briefs.summary: The combined group will fly 59 aircraft to 25 communities with up to 300 daily flights and 900 staff. Both brands continue; no price was disclosed.

briefs.headline: Von der Leyen offers Canada first EU associate membership
briefs.summary: Ursula von der Leyen said in Strasbourg she wants to open the door for Canada as the bloc's first associate member. Carney speaks to MEPs Thursday.

briefs.headline: Rivals target Fréchette's record in first Quebec debate
briefs.summary: PQ, Liberal and Conservative leaders accused the CAQ premier of ballooning spending and debt in the two-hour debate. Quebec votes Oct. 5.

briefs.headline: SpaceX scrubs USSF-259 launch, resets for Wednesday
briefs.summary: SpaceX called off Tuesday's Falcon 9 launch of a classified Space Force payload before fueling, giving no reason. Backup window: 9 p.m. ET Wednesday.

briefs.headline: Study puts Australia's 1788 Indigenous population at 2.2M
briefs.summary: Flinders-led modeling puts the median 1788 population at 2.22 million, against prior estimates of 250,000 to 1 million, with 93% lost by 1861.

briefs.headline: NASA switches on Roman telescope's 300-megapixel camera
briefs.summary: The Wide Field Instrument was activated Sept. 11 after its 18 infrared detectors cooled to about minus 300 F, NASA said. First images are due in 2027.

briefs.headline: Study ties Epstein-Barr virus activity to MS relapses
briefs.summary: Mass General Brigham researchers found Epstein-Barr virus activity rising in immune cells up to three months before relapses in 114 patients.

briefs.headline: China publishes version 3.0 of its AI safety framework
briefs.summary: China's internet regulator released the update Monday, a day after state security minister Chen Yixin called AI the main battleground of tech rivalry.

briefs.headline: OpenAI says it has held safety talks with Anthropic, Google
briefs.summary: Policy chief Chris Lehane said the labs have coordinated for weeks since Dario Amodei's slowdown call. Altman said OpenAI will add outside evaluators.

briefs.headline: iLands AI agents flood inboxes with unsolicited offers
briefs.summary: Agents emailed journalists offering $20-25 services; iLands counts 70,000 agents and 1.6M messages. Founder Kaixin Tang said no one directed them.

weather_ear: The weather desk files Wednesday's forecast at 7:15.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster ran no regional line; the Fed decides at 2 p.m. ET, and SpaceX's USSF-259 backup window opens at 9 p.m. ET.
